## Data Retrieval

```{r fetch-data, cache=TRUE}
# Fetch stock performance data
fetch_stock_performance <- function(symbol, from_date, to_date) {
  tryCatch({
    data <- getSymbols(symbol, src = "yahoo", from = from_date, to = to_date, auto.assign = FALSE)
    if (is.null(data) || nrow(data) < 20) return(NULL)
    prices <- Cl(data)
    n <- nrow(data)
    current_price <- round(as.numeric(tail(prices, 1)), 2)
    start_price <- as.numeric(prices[1])
    
    data.frame(
      Symbol = symbol,
      Last_Price = current_price,
      Return_12M = round(((current_price - start_price) / start_price) * 100, 2),
      Return_6M = round(((current_price - as.numeric(prices[max(1, n-126)])) / 
                          as.numeric(prices[max(1, n-126)])) * 100, 2),
      Return_3M = round(((current_price - as.numeric(prices[max(1, n-63)])) / 
                          as.numeric(prices[max(1, n-63)])) * 100, 2),
      Return_1M = round(((current_price - as.numeric(prices[max(1, n-21)])) / 
                          as.numeric(prices[max(1, n-21)])) * 100, 2),
      High_52W = round(max(as.numeric(Hi(data)), na.rm = TRUE), 2),
      Low_52W = round(min(as.numeric(Lo(data)), na.rm = TRUE), 2),
      Pct_From_High = round(((current_price - max(as.numeric(Hi(data)), na.rm = TRUE)) / 
                              max(as.numeric(Hi(data)), na.rm = TRUE)) * 100, 2),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }, error = function(e) NULL)
}

# Fetch all stocks
all_sector_results <- list()

for (etf in names(sector_holdings)) {
  sector_info <- sector_holdings[[etf]]
  cat(sprintf("Fetching %s (%s)...\n", etf, sector_info$name))
  
  sector_results <- data.frame()
  for (stock in sector_info$stocks) {
    result <- fetch_stock_performance(stock, start_date, end_date)
    if (!is.null(result)) sector_results <- rbind(sector_results, result)
    Sys.sleep(0.2)
  }
  
  if (nrow(sector_results) > 0) {
    all_sector_results[[etf]] <- sector_results %>%
      arrange(desc(Return_12M)) %>%
      head(10) %>%
      mutate(Rank = row_number())
  }
}
```

## Sector Performance {.tabset .tabset-pills}

```{r generate-tables, results='asis'}
# Generate a tab for each sector
for (etf in names(all_sector_results)) {
  sector_name <- sector_holdings[[etf]]$name
  results <- all_sector_results[[etf]]
  
  cat(sprintf("\n\n### %s (%s)\n\n", sector_name, etf))
  
  # Create GT table
  display_df <- results %>%
    select(Rank, Symbol, Last_Price, Return_12M, Return_6M, Return_3M, Return_1M, Pct_From_High) %>%
    rename(`#` = Rank, Price = Last_Price, `12M %` = Return_12M, `6M %` = Return_6M,
           `3M %` = Return_3M, `1M %` = Return_1M, `From Hi` = Pct_From_High)
  
  tbl <- display_df %>%
    gt() %>%
    tab_header(
      title = md(sprintf("**%s (%s) - Top 10 Stocks by 12-Month Return**", etf, sector_name)),
      subtitle = md(sprintf("*%s to %s*", end_date - years(1), end_date))
    ) %>%
    fmt_number(columns = Price, decimals = 2) %>%
    fmt_number(columns = c(`12M %`, `6M %`, `3M %`, `1M %`, `From Hi`), 
               decimals = 1, force_sign = TRUE) %>%
    tab_style(style = list(cell_text(color = "white", weight = "bold"), 
                            cell_fill(color = "#1a5c1a")),
              locations = cells_title()) %>%
    tab_style(style = list(cell_text(color = "white", weight = "bold"), 
                            cell_fill(color = "#333333")),
              locations = cells_column_labels()) %>%
    tab_style(style = cell_text(color = "white"), locations = cells_body()) %>%
    tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"), locations = cells_body(columns = Symbol)) %>%
    cols_align(align = "center", columns = everything())
  
  # Color rows by 12M return
  for (i in 1:nrow(results)) {
    ret <- results$Return_12M[i]
    bg <- if (ret > 50) "#1a8c1a" else if (ret > 30) "#2d8f2d" else if (ret > 15) "#4CAF50"
          else if (ret > 5) "#6dbf6d" else if (ret > 0) "#8fbc8f"
          else if (ret > -10) "#d4a017" else if (ret > -20) "#e67e22" else "#c0392b"
    tbl <- tbl %>% tab_style(style = cell_fill(color = bg), locations = cells_body(rows = i))
  }
  
  tbl <- tbl %>% tab_options(table.background.color = "#1a1a2e", table.font.size = px(13))
  
  print(htmltools::tagList(tbl))
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

```{r top-20}
all_combined <- bind_rows(
  lapply(names(all_sector_results), function(etf) {
    all_sector_results[[etf]] %>%
      mutate(Sector_ETF = etf, Sector_Name = sector_holdings[[etf]]$name)
  })
)

top_20 <- all_combined %>%
```

## Sector Comparison Chart

```{r comparison-chart, fig.width=14, fig.height=8}
# Average 12M return per sector
sector_avg <- all_combined %>%
  group_by(Sector_ETF, Sector_Name) %>%
  summarize(
    Avg_12M = mean(Return_12M, na.rm = TRUE),
    Best_Stock = Symbol[which.max(Return_12M)],
    Best_Return = max(Return_12M, na.rm = TRUE),
    Worst_Stock = Symbol[which.min(Return_12M)],
    Worst_Return = min(Return_12M, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Avg_12M))

ggplot(sector_avg, aes(x = reorder(Sector_Name, Avg_12M), y = Avg_12M, 
                        fill = Avg_12M)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%+.1f%%", Avg_12M)), 
            hjust = ifelse(sector_avg$Avg_12M > 0, -0.1, 1.1), 
            color = "white", size = 4) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#c0392b", mid = "#f39c12", high = "#27ae60", midpoint = 0) +
  labs(title = "Average 12-Month Return by Sector (Top 10 Stocks)",
       subtitle = sprintf("%s to %s", end_date - years(1), end_date),
       x = "", y = "Average 12-Month Return (%)") +
  theme_dark() +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#1a1a2e"),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#16213e"),
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text = element_text(color = "white", size = 11),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "white"),
    plot.title = element_text(color = "#00ff88", size = 16, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "#aaaaaa"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "#2a2a4a"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
  )
```

## Scatter: Return vs Risk

```{r scatter-plot, fig.width=12, fig.height=7}
# Plot each stock's 12M return vs 1M return (momentum)
scatter_df <- all_combined %>%
  select(Symbol, Sector_Name, Return_12M, Return_1M, Return_3M)

ggplot(scatter_df, aes(x = Return_3M, y = Return_12M, color = Sector_Name)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Symbol), size = 2.5, vjust = -0.8, color = "white", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  labs(title = "Sector Stocks: 12-Month Return vs 3-Month Momentum",
       x = "3-Month Return (%)", y = "12-Month Return (%)", color = "Sector") +
  theme_dark() +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#1a1a2e"),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#16213e"),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "#1a1a2e"),
    legend.text = element_text(color = "white", size = 9),
    legend.title = element_text(color = "white"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "white"),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "white"),
    plot.title = element_text(color = "#00ff88", size = 14, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#2a2a4a"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```
